title: Revisiting Hall-Petch strengthening in FCC multi-principal element alloys: data and analysis pipeline
description:
Dataset and complete analysis pipeline for the manuscript Revisiting Hall-Petch strengthening in FCC multi-principal element alloys: what grain size, composition, and processing can and cannot explain.

Contains 94 single-phase FCC alloy conditions spanning 82 compositions in the Al-Co-Cr-Cu-Fe-Mn-Ni-V system, produced and characterized under one processing route. Eighty-one compositions carry chemistry, grain size, yield strength and Vickers hardness together.

The repository holds the raw dataset, the five-family modelling hierarchy (classical Hall-Petch, physics-derived descriptors, composition and processing, non-linear estimators, symbolic regression), the 5-fold / leave-one-out / leave-one-batch-out validation protocol, the tiered literature stress test, and regression tests that recompute every headline value from the raw data and fail if the manuscript drifts from it.
